bathAction.title: Eagerly
bathAction.tooltip: Set the default pace to eager. A part you have already washed still offers all three.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(lean)] into the heat, already smiling, and [npc.verb(let)] out [npc.a_moan+] as [npc.she] [npc.verb(decide)] to enjoy the rest of it. [npc.speech(I want to enjoy every bit of this. Do not hurry me.)]
